title: India’s online gaming crackdown and its new regulator
dek: Real-money games are banned. A new authority now decides what counts as esports or a social game.
seoTitle: Online gaming rules 2026 timeline: real-money ban and the new regulator
bigLabel: Under rules in force since 1 May 2026

glance.what: Since 1 May 2026, online games with money stakes are banned, and the Online Gaming Authority of India classifies and registers games.
glance.why: It reshaped one of India’s fastest-growing digital industries, from fantasy sports to esports and game studios.
glance.next: Which titles the authority clears as esports or social games.

forYou: Games with no money at stake can keep running without mandatory registration unless the authority asks. Platforms must store Indian users’ data in India and offer age checks and parental controls.
next: Which games are cleared as esports or social games.

events.title: Parliament passes the gaming law
events.summary: Hours after the Rajya Sabha clears the bill, India’s largest fantasy-sports platform stops all paid contests.

events.title: Gaming Rules notified; regulator set up
events.summary: The IT ministry notifies the Promotion and Regulation of Online Gaming Rules, 2026 and constitutes a six-member Online Gaming Authority of India.

events.title: Rules take effect; real-money games banned
events.summary: The authority goes live. It classifies games as money games, social games or esports, with a 90-day determination process. Esports certificates can last up to 10 years.
